    - ...
  blind spot:
LENS 4 — FIRST PRINCIPLES:

    - ...
  blind spot:
LENS 5 — PRO VS AMATEUR:
  findings:                       # the observable standard
    - ...
  blind spot:

TERRAIN GATE (the nine questions answered):
  evidence gaps:
  contradictions:
  dependencies:

VERDICT: TERRAIN CLEAR / REVISE (round N of 2) / TERRAIN BLOCKED
  if BLOCKED: what evidence would clear it
